Commentary.Commentary: On the other hand, the Lankan bowlers looked completely clueless and lacked ideas. Angelo Mathews was their standout bowler as he rocked the Indian middle order with two back-to-back wickets and maidens as well. Apart from him, all the other bowlers received a hammering. Lasith Malinga scalped Virat Kohli as his 300th wicket in ODIs which was the only positive thing for him. A mammoth target awaits them in the second innings and they will have to bat really well. The wicket is a belter and might just get better under lights. Let us hope we are in for a cracking encounter. Join us in a while.

Once the 219-run partnership for the second wicket broke, Sri Lanka pulled things back with a few quick wickets. However, Manish Pandey and the ever-reliable MS Dhoni steadied the ship and ensured that there were no further hiccups with an unbeaten 101-run stand. The visitors however would still feel they are at least 20 runs short of where they could have been.

What a scintillating batting display by the Indians there. After winning the toss and opting to bat, this was exactly what they would have been hoping for. They did not get off to the best of starts as they lost Dhawan early but Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma smashed the Lankan bowlers black and blue. With both of them scoring tons, India at one point looked like they would reach 400.

Second ODI fifty for Manish Pandey! Full toss on middle and off, Pandey tries to have a whack at it but ends up mistiming it over mid-wicket. Only a single results. With this Manish Pandey gets to his half century while Dhoni is left stranded on 49! INDIA FINISH ON 375/5! This is the third highest first-innings total in Sri Lanka and the highest against the hosts.
100-run stand between Manish Pandery and MS Dhoni.

Full and angling in, Dhoni drills it hard towards long on. He turns around for the second but Pandey sends him back. The 100-run stand between these two is up. It has been a valuable stand for the visitors!
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Slower delivery outside off, sliced through cover-point for a brace. Good running, this!
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
FOUR! That's been smashed! Full outside off, Dhoni clears his front leg and thumps it over extra cover for a boundary.
Fuller ball outside off, driven off the toe end to long off for a single.
Wide outside off, slanting away. Dhoni again fails to squeeze it out.

Slower one on a length around off, Dhoni gets back and punches it with power through covers. Mendis in the deep, runs to his left and stops with a superb diving effort. Saves a couple of runs for his team. This is now the highest first-innings total in a Sri Lanka-India game in the Island!
FOUR! Dhoni keeps on punishing! Full toss around off, Dhoni slams it over extra cover for a boundary.
Wide outside off, slanting across. Dhoni looks to jam it out but ends up hitting the bat hard into the deck.
Played with the angled bat towards point for a single.
Full outside off, driven hard through covers for a couple.
SIX! Bang! Another slower one on the stumps, Dhoni gets across and clobbers it over mid-wicket for a biggie. All eyes on Munaweera.
Slower delivery on the shorter side, Dhoni waits for it and slaps it through covers for a brace.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Slower one around middle, Pandey shuffles across and works it behind square on the leg side for a brace.

In the air and dropped! The fielding woes continue for Sri Lanka! Slower one wide outside off, Dhoni looks to hammer it away but ends up getting a top edge. The ball swirls high in the air. Munaweera at backward point, gets under the ball but ends up spilling it. Malinga is not happy and he starts walking back to his run-up mark. A single is taken. Dhoni gets a reprieve and he will now look to make the most of his life.
Pandey shimmies down the track and drives it past mid off. Mathews from long off, gets across and keeps the batsmen down to a brace.
High full toss, punched to long off for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide outside off, squeezed past the backward point fielder for a brace.
FOUR! Easily done! Full and slanting away from the batsman. Pandey goes inside out over extra cover with nice timing on it. The ball goes on a couple of bounces across the fence.
Full outside off, Dhoni kneels down and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower one around off, defended with soft hands in the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Dhoni power! Full outside off, Dhoni smashes it over extra cover. The ball just falls short of the fence there and a boundary is signalled. The runs keep on coming!
Full outside off, driven through covers crisply. Unluckily for Dhoni, he found the fielder there. A dot ball results!
Almost a yorker on middle, dug out through mid-wicket for a single.
Wide full toss, sliced to deep cover for a single.
Full and angling in, drilled to long on for a single.
50-run stand between Pandey and Dhoni.
Wide! Harsh call! Slower one wide outside off, Pandey gets across and looks to dab it away but misses. The umpire spreads his arms to signal a wide. Malinga is not happy seeing that one.

Length delivery around leg, punched through mid-wicket. Pandey takes off for a single but Dhoni waits in between. After making sure the ball went past the man at mid-wicket, Dhoni crosses by for a single.

FOUR! Well placed! Angling away from the right-hander. Manish Pandey cleverly uses the angle and just guides it finer down the off side. Even short third man can't get to it and the ball races away to the fence. India crosses the 320-run mark!
Slanting away from Dhoni, he plays with the angle through covers for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, dug out back to the bowler.
Very full outside off, tapped to the right of the man at short third man for a single.
Slanting away from the batsman, glided past backward point. Sweeper cover hares to his left and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Vishwa Fernando is back into the attack.
FOUR! Drilled hard! Full around off, Dhoni tonks it hard down the ground. Beats the man at mid off and finds the fence. 9 runs off the over!
Slower one on a length wide outside off, dabbed behind point for a single.
Very full around off, Dhoni digs it out past the extra cover fielder towards long off. With this, he goes past Adam Gilchrist in the list of the highest run-getters in ODIs.
Wide! Once again it's wide outside off. Dhoni makes a leave and gets another wide.
Very full around off, jammed to short cover.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
Wide! Sprays it wide outside off. Dhoni stands his ground and leaves it alone. A wide is signalled.
A full toss on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Lasith Malinga brings himself back into the attack.
Served on middle, straightening a touch, worked through the on side for a single.
Shortish around middle, pulled towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Once again Siriwardana gets his line wrong. Sprays it outside leg, Dhoni shovels it fine down the leg side and the ball races away to the fence. Second boundary of the over and that brings up 300 for India!
Served fuller around off, defended off the front foot.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Really poor ball, this! Short and sliding down leg. Pandey covers his stumps and slams it over backward square leg for a boundary. India trying to get a move on.
Shortish outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
Dhoni dances down the track and pushes it down the track for a single.
Shortish outside off, chopped to point.
Fuller around middle, Dhoni dances down and places it in the mid-wicket region. Sprints for the first and comes back for the second with ease. Both, Dhoni and Pandey are brisk runners.
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.

FOUR! Great use of the feet and wrists! Pandey dances down the track and whips it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep puts in a full-stretched dive but fails to prevent it from crossing the fence. A boundary after 43 balls!

Sharp turn there! Slower through the air outside off, stops a touch and spins away sharply. Dhoni looks to push it away from his body but gets beaten. Dickwella collects and whips the bails off but Dhoni's feet are firmly planted. What an over, just one from it!
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Floated around off, Pandey drives it but again finds the fielder. This time it's straight back to Siriwardana.
Tossed up around off, driven nicely but finds the man at covers.
Slower through the air outside off, tapped to point.
Sliding into the pads, worked on the leg side.
Milinda Siriwardana is back on. So, left-arm spinners from both ends now.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. Now, a maximum of 5 fielders are allowed outside the circle.
Full outside off, Pandey waits for it and drives it through covers for a single.
Dhoni uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and milks down to long off for a single.
Slower through the air outside off, pushed off the front foot back to the bowler.
Served wide outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Full around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Sliding into the pads, turned in the square leg region for a single.
Malinda Pushpakumara replaces Dananjaya!
Shorter in length on off, Dhoni defends it solidly. A maiden for Mathews.

Comes running in and bowls it from wide of the crease. Angles it on the leg stump. Dhoni tries to flick but misses and the ball hits him on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire remains put. That would have been sliding down leg.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
Fuller in length on off, Dhoni defends it off the front foot.
Length ball on off, Dhoni tucks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length around off, Dhoni plays it to point.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR LEG BYES! Darts it on the pads, Dhoni fails to flick it and it goes off the pads to the short leg fielder. Mendis there collects and has a shy at the non-striker's end to everyone's surprise. Malinga did not expect it and was not backing up as the ball crosses the rope. That would have been close as Pandey was backing up a long way there.
MS Dhoni now walks out to the middle. 300th ODI for him and he will surely look to make it count.

OUT! Dananjaya strikes! Another one bites the dust! Rahul's poor run in this series continues and he falls to Dananjaya again. Bowls a googly on middle, Rahul flicks it uppishly to the man at short mid-wicket. Wanidu Hasaranga there jumps and takes a very easy catch. Sri Lanka are just crawling their way back into the game. A soft dismissal there. India's middle-order woes continue. The visitors have lost half their side.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Flatter on leg stump, turning in. Rahul tucks it around the corner for a run.
Floats it on off, Pandey eases it down to long on for a run.
Bowls a cutter on off, Pandey pushes it down to long on for a run.
Length ball outside off, Rahul guides it down to third man for a run.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on a length on middle, Rahul defends it solidly.
Shorter in length on middle, Pandey pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Similar length outside off, Rahul leans into it and drives it through covers for a run this time.
Fuller in length on off, Rahul drives it through covers for a couple.
Gives it air on off, Pandey defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker on off, tunring back in. Pandey defends it off the back foot.
Loopy ball on off, Rahul taps it through covers for a run.
Flighted outside off, Pandey drives it through covers for a run.
Flatter on off, Rahul plays it through the off side for a run.
Akila Dananjaya comes back into the attack.
Shorter in length on off, Pandey plays it to point. A double wicket maiden from Mathews! What an over, this! Can very well prove to be the difference in the end total.
Almost! Bangs in another short one around off. Pandey first thinks about ducking but then tries to pull it awkwardly and gets beaten. Almost a hat-trick there for Angelo.
Manish Pandey strides out to bat. He will be facing the hat-trick ball from Angelo Mathews in his comeback game. Let's see what happens next...

OUT! Two-in-two for Mathews. Just the over Sri Lanka needed! This time it is the centurion who is walking back. The short ball does the trick again. Angelo bangs it in short on off, Sharma tries to upper cut it but gets a feather to Dickwella who pouches it. He appeals and the umpire raises his finger. A very entertaining knock by Rohit comes to an end. Mathews is on a hat-trick. An opening here for the Islanders with two new batsmen now at the crease.
Lokesh Rahul is the new man in.

OUT! The drop does not cost them a lot. Dananjaya will breathe a sigh of relief! Mathews bangs in a short one, which gets big on Pandya. Hardik pulls it but fails to keep it down and holes out to Hasaranga at deep mid-wicket. He makes no mistake, runs to his left and takes it. Mathews finally gets his man. An important wicket for the Lankans. The crowd erupts here in Colombo.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

DROPPED! Oh, Dananjaya you cannot be dropping these! Mathews bowls a slower one on off, Pandya tries to go over cover but does not get the elevation and hits it to the fielder there. Akila gets two hands to it but spills it. How costly could this drop prove? We all know how dangerous Pandya can get. Mathews is not pleased here.
Angelo Mathews is back on for a spell.
FOUR! Bangs in a short one again. Rohit takes on the challenge of pulling this time. Mistimes it and it goes fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Bouncer on middle, Sharma ducks under it.
13th ODI hundred for Rohit Sharma.

FOUR! Century for Rohit Sharma! Take a bow, Hitman. Back-to-back hundreds for him. First Indian to achieve this in the Island. He is on a roll here. Sharma also gets to his ton in style. Malinga bowls a full toss on leg stump. Rohit times his drive through mid on for a boundary. He is extremely happy and celebrates with a huge smile on his face and with his hands aloft.
He almost got deceived there! Bowls a slower ball which dips on the batsman on middle, Hardik adjusts well and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Off pace delivery on middle, Pandya drives it to mid-wicket.
Slower one on the leg stump, Rohit flicks it through square leg for a run.
Time for Drinks.
Nails the sweep shot to deep square leg for a run.
Quicker on off, Pandya punches it down to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, Sharma punches it through mid on for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Pandya cuts it towards point. The fielder there does not put in a dive and concedes three.
SIX! TONKED! Tosses it up this time, Pandya goes down on one knee and hits it over the long on fence for a maximum. He is just going after every ball here.
Flatter on off, Pandya goes for a heave but gets a bottom edge as the ball rolls to the keeper.
Shorter in length on middle, Pandya pulls it through square leg for a run.
Excellent, excellent bowling! Shades of the old Malinga there. A fast yorker on leg stump, Pandya does extremely well to dig it out to mid-wicket.
Slower delivery on off, Sharma flicks it to through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Sharma flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length on off, Pandya tucks it towards mid-wicket where the fielder fumbles and concedes a run.
Tucks it around the corner for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

NOT OUT! A successful review for India! Danajaya sees Pandya coming down the track and shortens his length. Pandya adjusts and tries to defend it but the ball goes off something to the fielder at short leg. He catches it and appeals as the umpire gives it out. Pandya immediately reviews, signalling that he has not hit it to Rohit. Replays show that there was no bat involved there, so they now check for the lbw. The impact is more than three meters down the track but it is umpire's call and it is shown to be going on to clip the top of the stumps. However, there seems to be some communication between the on-field and the third umpire about it being not out for the lbw. The decision is overturned. Pandya survives to live another day.
Hardik Pandya has been adjudged caught at short leg. He though is sure that he has not nicked it and has taken the review straightaway.
FOUR! BOOM! That was hit hard. Pandya once again uses his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball. He bludgeons it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Tosses it up on off, Pandya defends it off the front foot.
A short leg is in place for Pandya.
Goes back in the crease and tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.

A poor piece of judgement there by Thirimanne! Pandya comes down the track and hits it aerially and flat towards long on. Lahiru runs ahead a touch but then stands his ground, collecting it on the bounce. The batsmen take a single. Thirimanne should have gone for the catch there. He maybe thought to better safe than sorry.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Easy-peasy! Full toss on the pads, Rohit eases it through mid on for a boundary. He moves into the 90s now.
Good length on off, Pandya gets it off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
So as mentioned earlier, it's Hardik Pandya who comes out to bat next. Expect the Indians to go all guns blazing from hereon.

OUT! 300th ODI wicket for Malinga! The bowling change has worked for the Lankans. Malinga comes running in and persists with the full length delivery outside off. Kohli seeing the width on offer goes after it and lofts it towards the man at sweeper cover. Munaweera there did not have to move an inch and takes an easy catch. The 219-run stand has been broken. The Sri Lankan players are all pumped, they needed this wicket. A magnificent knock from the Indian skipper has come to an end. The change in bat has brought about a change in fortune for Kohli. He walks off to a standing ovation. Malinga receives a hug from Rohit Sharma on achieving the feat, a nice gesture from the opener there. Can the Lankans now build on this wicket?

Bowls it very full. Almost a yorker on off, Kohli digs it out towards cover-point. Rohit wanted a run there but was sent back by Kohli. The fielder was quick to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. No harm done there. A direct hit would have been close.
Change of bat for Virat Kohli as he wants his current bat to be taped.
Yorker outside off, Kohli jams it out on the off side.
Lasith Malinga is back into the attack. The skipper needs to step up and get the much-needed breakthrough!
Works it around the corner for a run.
Rohit comes down the track. Dananjaya fires it down the leg side. Sharma misses the flick and the ball brushes his pads and goes to short fine leg.

FOUR! WOW! We are running out of superlatives for how these two are batting. Tossed up ball on off, Rohit lofts it over the mid off fielder for a boundary. Now the question here is why is the mid off fielder inside the ring?
Fires it on the pads, Kohli flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Sloppy, very sloppy from Hasaranga! Nothing seems to be going right for the home side. Virat uses his feet and gets down to the pitch of the ball. He flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there runs to his left gets to the ball but lets it through his legs for a boundary. This is not what Sri Lanka need at the moment.
Short and angling in, Virat plays a controlled pull through mid-wicket for a single.
Another short delivery outside off, Kohli plays an overhead smash through wide mid on for a brace.

Back of a length delivery wide outside off, Kohli stands tall and cuts it through covers. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and puts in a dive to make a vital stop. Saves a couple of runs for his team.
FOUR! Full toss and punished! Angles in a juicy full toss. Kohli clears his front leg and smashes it through wide mid on for a boundary. This is poor bowling from Sri Lanka!
Wide outside off, Rohit reaches out for it and gets it through covers for a single.
200-run stand is up between Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli!

Fernando comes from around the wicket, spears it into the stumps, Kohli drives it towards mid on. Malinga there fumbles and searches for the ball. This allows the batsmen to steal a single. 200-run stand is up and this is the third one for the duo. Kohli is now involved in his 10th double century stand.
Served around middle, punched down to long on for a single.
A touch shortish around off, chopped onto the off side.
Sliding into the pads, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up around off, gently pushed in the cover-point region for a single.
Served around middle and leg, turned behind square on the leg side for a single.
Akila Dananjaya is back into the attack.
Tapped in the point region for a single.
Full and slanting away, driven to long off for a single.
FOUR! Just flick of the wrists! Fuller around leg, Kohli shuffles across and plays across the line through mid-wicket. With Kohli in this form, you know there's only one result - a boundary!
Hardik Pandya is padded up and he is also warming up. He might be coming in next.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

SIX! Awesome! That is some shot! A good length delivery, angling across. Kohli walks out and just lofts it with the angle straight down the ground. He times it so well that the ball just flies into the stands.
Vishwa Fernando is back on!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Well played, Sir! Full outside off, Sharma carves it past a diving Malinga at backward point. The ball just races away to the fence. Both these players are just cruising through at the moment.
Kohli gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to long off for a single.
Full outside off, milked down to long off for a single.
Punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
29th ODI ton for Virat Kohli!

FOUR! Another century for the Indian skipper! Virat Kohli just keeps getting those! It is a poor delivery from Siriwardana, short and sliding down leg. Virat just camps back and hammers it away over backward square leg. It goes on the bounce across the fence. Gets to his ton in just 76 balls. What an innings it has been, absolutely superb!

SIX! Lovely! The last two deliveries has just undone the good work of the last couple of overs. Full around off, Sharma dances down and lofts it inside out over covers. Times it so well and gets it off the meat as well. The ball just sails over the fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and wide outside off. Rohit cashes in on the width by cracking it away through point for a boundary.
Straighter delivery on middle and off, Kohli clears his front leg and knocks it towards long on for a single.
Full around off, pushed to covers.
A touch short on middle, straightens a touch. Rohit goes back and punches it down through wide mid on for a single.
Slower through the air outside off, spinning away. Played with soft hands towards point.
A touch shortish around middle, skids on with the arm. Sharma goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Arm ball around middle and off, eased down to long on for a single.
Served outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Great placement! Sliding down leg, Kohli camps back and works it through backward square leg. It's a big gap there and a couple is taken with ease.
Turned straight to square leg by Rohit.
Flicked through mid-wicket for another single.
Fuller around leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air around off, Rohit gets behind the line of the ball and blocks.
Sharma prods forward and defends.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

Shout for lbw, turned down! Sliding down leg, Sharma kneels down to sweep but misses. Gets rapped on the front pad and the players appeal. The umpire though stays put. Interestingly, the Hawk Eye shows the ball to straighten a touch and clip the leg pole. So, it would have stayed umpire's call!
Served wide outside off, placed in the backward point region for a single.
Slower through the air around off, Kohli blocks it on the off side.

FOUR Typical Kohli! His wristwork is just amazing. Shimmies down the track and whips it with the angle. Finds the gap in the cow corner region and collects another boundary. Superb use of bottom hand there by Virat!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Slightly shorter around off, punched through mid on for a single.
Milinda Siriwardana is now introduced into the attack.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tosses it up on middle and leg. Turns a touch away from the batsman. Kohli tries to flick but gets a leading edge down towards long on for a run.
Fuller outside off, Sharma drives it through covers for a run.
Floats it on off, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted ball on off, Sharma drives it through covers for a run.
Loopy ball on off, turning away. Rohit drives it with the spin to the man at covers.
Angles it into the pads, Sharma flicks it around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Raining boundaries here in Colombo! Shorter in length outside off, Sharma goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Three consecutive deliveries goes to the man at long on. Flighted ball outside off, Kohli plants his front foot forward and drives it through mid on for a run.

Fifty up for Rohit Sharma. 33rd fifty for him. It has been a very entertaining knock by the opener. This is his third fifty-plus score of the series. He is playing second fiddle to the skipper but still going at over more than run-a-ball. The ball was tossed up on leg stump which Sharma drove towards long on for a run.
Flatter on off, Kohli punches it through mid on for a run.
Bowls it on the stumps, Kohli flicks it but straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Flighted ball on off, Virat leans into it and drives it through long off for a run.
Floats it on middle, Kohli drives it back to the bowler.
Quicker and angling it into the batsman. Rohit flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller outside off, Sharma drives it beautifully to the man at covers.
He is not flighting it up to Kohli. Flatter on off, Virat pushes it down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Rohit eases it down to long on for a run.

Time for Drinks. So after losing the early wicket of Dhawan, Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma have opted for a counter-attacking approach. They have managed to score very freely and are cruising at the moment. The Lankans are in a desperate need of a wicket here or these two might just take the game away from them.
Fires it into the pads, Sharma works it around the corner for a run.
FOUR! SHOT! Akila bowls a leg spinner but too full on off. Rohit picks it early and thrashes it over wide mid off for a boundary. That was stand and deliver stuff from Sharma.
Drags his length back on off, turning away this time. Rohit pushes it off the back foot to the man at covers.
Flatter on off, Kohli camps back and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Nudges it with the spin to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Slower through the air on middle, turning back in. Kohli plays it to mid-wicket.
Change of ends for Akila Dananjaya.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Streaky! Flatter delivery wide outside off. Sharma presents a front foot defence. Gets an outside edge and the ball races away to the third man fence. The short third man fielder tried chasing it down but the ball just kept racing away.
Fuller in the line of the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! That went miles! Tossed up around middle and off, Kohli skips down the track and clobbers it over long on for a maximum. That's a huge hit. Kohli is just punishing every bad delivery he is facing.
Floated around off, Sharma turns it through wide mid on for a single.
Slower through the air around middle and off, Virat prods forward and eases it down to long on for a single.
Malinda Pushpakumara is back into the attack, replaces Dananjaya!
Loopy ball on off, Kohli drives it down to long on for a run.
Fuller in length, Sharma pushes it down to long on for a run.
Floats it up on off, Kohli drives it through the cover region to pick up a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Poor delivery! Drags his length back on off, Kohli rocks onto the back foot and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. This is getting too easy for the away side.
100-run stand between Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli. 11th one for these two in 55 innings.
FOUR! A great way to start the over! Fuller outside off, Kohli drives it through the covers. The fielder in the deep dives but in vain as the ball crosses the ropes.
SIX! A maximum to finish the over. Tosses it up on off, turning back in. Rohit Sharma goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it with the spin over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Great use of the feet there! Comes down the track, seeing him advance Dananjaya bowls it short. Sharma has all the time in the world and he pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Slower through the air on middle, Sharma tucks it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Flatter on off, Sharma plays it to the man at covers.
Tosses it up on off, Kohli leans into it and drives it down to long off for a run.
Fuller outside off, Kohli drives it through covers for a run.

FOUR! DEFT! Lovely placement by Kohli. Bowls a leg spinner on off, Virat waits for it and guides it through short third man for a boundary. That was very delicately played. He is also now the fifth player to score 2000-plus runs against Sri Lanka in ODIs.
Drags his length back on middle, Sharma pushes it down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, Kohli drives it with ease through covers to pick up a single.
Flatter on off, Kohli defends it towards covers.
There was a kite on the ground and so a slight delay.
Shorter in length outside off, Rohit punches it through covers for a run.
Wanidu Hasaranga comes into the attack.
Works it around the corner with the spin for a run.
Bowls a google on off, Kohli reads it well and drives it through mid on for a run.
Drags his length back on the stumps, Sharma pushes it down to long on for a run.
Bowls an off spinner on middle, Rohit nudges it towards square leg and runs two.
Slower through the air on off, Sharma lunges forward in defense.
Flatter on off, turning back into the batsman. Rohit works it to square leg.
Akila Dananjaya comes into the attack. He has had a gala time with the ball in this series.
Shortish delivery, angling in. Sharma rides the bounce and pulls it away on the leg side for a single.
45th ODI fifty for Virat Kohli.

Length delivery outside off, tapped in the cover-point region for a quick single. Kohli reaches his half century with it and that too off just 38 deliveries. It's his 12th one against Sri Lanka. He has looked in a sublime touch so far and he will definitely look to make it big.
Wide! Once again Malinga gets his line wrong. Slants it down the leg side and Kohli lets it go. Second wide of the over.
Wide outside off, glided to third man for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Wide! Sprays it down the leg side. Kohli misses his flick and a wide is signalled.

FOUR! Kohli is putting everything away! Malinga bangs it short, angling into the batsman. Kohli is a touch surprised but still goes through with the pull shot. Is not much in control of it but does well to play it finer. The ball beats the man in the deep and runs across the fence.
Starts off with a slower one, very full on middle and leg. Sharma clips it late in the square leg region for a single.
Another bowling change. Skipper Lasith Malinga brings himself back on. Powerplay 2 has been signalled as well. Now, 4 fielders can stay outside the ring till the 40th over.
Bowls an arm ball on the pads, Kohli flicks it to square leg.
Drags his length back on the stumps, Sharma punches it off the back foot down to long on for a run.
He does it again! Flighted ball on middle, Kohli smashes it back past the bowler. The ball hits the stumps again and deflects towards long off for a run. A certain boundary was saved there.
FOUR! Exquisite! Gives it air outside off, Kohli drives it through the covers this time for a boundary. He is playing something special here.

FOUR! That is drilled! Kohli has absolutely smashed that! Fuller in length on middle, Kohli hits it back past the bowler, the ball hits the stumps and still had enough to go to the long on fence for a boundary. He is now the highest scorer in ODIs in 2017.
50-run stand between Kohli and Sharma.
Floats it on off, Kohli drives it hard through the covers and collects  a brace.
Shorter in length outside off, gets some inward movement. Sharma goes for the cut but chops it to the man at point.
Lands it on a length on off, Sharma defends it off the front foot.
SIX! BANG! RO-HIT SHARMA! Shorter in length by Mathews on middle, sits up to be hit. Sharma pulls it off the front foot over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Lands it on a length on middle, stops on the batsman a touch. Sharma defends it solidly.
Just behind a length on off, Kohli taps it down towards point for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flights it on off, Kohli eases it to long off for a run.
Plays it with the angle towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, Kohli drives it through mid off for a run.

NOT OUT! A confusion which almost leads to a run out. Angles it into the pads, Kohli flicks it a touch in front of square on the leg side. He sets off for a run but is sent back by his partner, who spots Dananjaya get to the ball quickly. Kohli is stranded halfway down the wicket, he turns back in a hurry and puts in a full stretch dive to reach in. The throw by Akila is a flat one towards the keeper. Dickwella collects the ball and takes the bails off in a flash and appeals. The umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that Kohli has made his ground. His dive saved him there. The Indian skipper survives a scare.
The square leg umpire has gone upstairs to check a run out against Kohli. He seems to be struggling here.
Very full on off, Kohli whips it down to mid on.
Quicker on off, goes on with the arm. Kohli drives it to mid off.
Malinda Pushpakumara the debutant is now into the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Now, Rohit Sharma joins the party! Fuller in length outside off, Rohit drives it over the cover fielder. The ball goes on one bounce across the fence.
Drifts it on the pads. Too easy for Sharma as he flicks it through mid-wicket and bags two.
Bowls it from wide of the crease and angles it into the pads. Sharma flicks it uppishly but just short of the man at mid-wicket.
Similar length on off, Rohit plays it towards covers. He wants a single but is sent back by his captain.
Lands it on a length on off, Rohit drives it towards point.

FOUR! This guy is class apart! He is using his feet to great effect. Fernando bowls a touch fuller on off, Kohli gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through mid off for another boundary. 10 runs from this over. He has gone for 23 in his last two.
Once again walks a step ahead and defends the length ball on off, towards point.
FOUR! Uses his feet again and gets a full toss on his pads. Easy for Kohli. He flicks it through widish mid on. Malinga there does not even bother giving it a chase and the ball crosses the fence.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bowls a cutter on middle, moves away a touch after pitching. Kohli tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge towards covers. A well-thought delivery by Fernando there.
Just ahead of a length around off, Kohli flicks it against the angle through mid-wicket for a brace.
Good length outside off, Sharma shoulders his arms to it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.

In the air... but safe! One shot too many maybe? Mathews bowls it a touch shorter outside off. Kohli goes for the cut but gets an outside edge which goes on a couple of bounces to the third man fielder. A single is taken. Kohli should not get too carried away here!
FOUR! Kohli is on the charge here! He shimmies down and also shuffles across to the full length ball outside off. He uses his wrists and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Mathews comes running in and lands it on a length. Kohli uses his feet but does not quite get to the pitch of the ball. He pushes it to the man at covers.
Angelo Mathews comes into the attack. Early change from Malinga. A widish first slip is in place there.
Back of a length on off, Kohli plays it towards point for a run. A good over for the Indians, 13 runs from it.
Shortens his length around off, Kohli defends it solidly.

FOUR! Three in a row! He is making up for the maiden that Fernando bowled in the previous over. Vishwa is not learning here. Persisting with the full length delivery but this time it's on middle. Kohli shuffles across and flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! This is even better. Full ball on off, Kohli times this to perfection past the diving mid off fielder and into the fence. Back-to-back boundaries for Kohli.
FOUR! Top class shot! Fullish length outside off, Kohli plants his front foot ahead and drives it through covers for a boundary. That was very pleasing to the eye.
Fuller in length angling away from the batsman. Kohli eases it to the man at covers who makes a good stop.
Good length on off, Kohli taps it towards covers and takes a quick run. Malinga is not getting a lot of swing here.
Bowls it on the pads, Sharma flicks it through square leg for a run.
WIDE! Angles it down the leg side, Rohit goes for the flick but fails to connect. The umpire signals a wide.
Good length around off, Kohli guides it down to third man with an angled bat to get off the mark.

Sprays it on the pads, Kohli tries to flick but is a touch early into the shot. He gets a soft leading edge towards mid on. He got squared up as he played that shot as the ball held a touch after pitching.
Fullish ball on off, Virat eases it to mid on.
Fullish outside off, Sharma taps it past backward point for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Virat taps it to point. Wicket-maiden from Fernando. He started off in a similar manner in the last game too.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full outside off, Kohli plays it to point.
Virat Kohli strides out to the middle.

OUT! Vishwa Fernando draws first blood for the Lankans. Dhawan, the man in form has to depart. Fernando bowls a length ball outside off, gets it to shape away from the batsman a touch. Seeing the width on offer, Dhawan goes after it but slices it to the man at third man. Pushpakumara stationed there, runs to his right and takes a nice catch. The Sri Lankans are ecstatic. A big wicket for them. Back-to-back failures for Dhawan!
Full and on the stumps, the batsman plays it towards mid-wicket.
Starts off with a fuller ball, delivering from closer to the stumps.  Dhawan goes for the drive but gets if off the inner half towards mid on.
Vishwa Fernando will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Fullish in length and swinging into the pads, Dhawan fails to flick and it goes off the pads towards fine leg for a leg bye.
Back to a length delivery on off, Dhawan tries to defend it but gets it off the inner half towards square leg.
FOUR! Trademark Dhawan! He is in such a good form. Fuller in length outside off, width on offer. Dhawan leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary. First boundary of the day!
Drifts it on the pads, Sharma flicks it towards square leg for a run. India are underway and so is Rohit Sharma.
Again a similar length on off, Sharma prods forward and blocks it.
The skipper starts off with a length delivery on off. Rohit Sharma lunges forward and blocks it towards point.

Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan stride out to open the innings for India. So no surprises there. Skipper Lasith Malinga to start the proceedings with the first new ball. He has a couple of slips in place. Let's play...

Lasith Malinga says that he anyways wanted to bowl first. Mentions that they would like to restrict the opposition to a below-par total. He hopes his team does well in today's game. Informs that they have three changes - Wanidu Hasaranga comes into the side with Malinda Pushpakumara and Dilshan Munaweera making their debut.

Virat Kohli says that they are going to bat first as it's hot and humid, not the best time to bowl. Expects the pitch to break down later in the day thus making the ball to misbehave. Adds that they wouldn't have asked to be in a better position, winning the Test series 3-0 and being 3-0 up in the ODI series. Further adds that it's all about being ruthless now. Informs that they presented MS Dhoni with a memento for playing in his 300th ODI and feels that he was fortunate to present him with it as the ex-skipper has been a legend of the game. Gives us an update of the three changes - Shardul Thakur makes his international debut while Kuldeep Yadav and Manish Pandey come in. Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Yuzvendra Chahal and Kedar Jadhav are the ones making their way out.
TOSS - India win the toss and opt to bat.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold and Zaheer Khan inspect the pitch together and inform that the hardness of the wicket is very good. They add further that there is an even covering of grass on it. They reckon there won't be a lot of swing. Mention that the surface is good for batting. Opine anything around 270-280 will be a good score. End by saying that the ball will come onto the bat well under the lights.

For the home side, their injury woes continue. The stand-in captain for the last game Chamara Kapugedera misses out due to an injury and Lasith Malinga will fill his boots in the captaincy role. The crowd showed their frustration with the team in the last ODI and nothing less than a win will be accepted. Their skipper will be hoping for the same to salvage some pride. Let's hope for an even encounter between bat and ball. Stay tuned for the toss.

We head down to RPS, Colombo for the fourth ODI between Sri Lanka and India. This could also be the 300th game for M.S Dhoni and he would be hoping to mark it off with a win. The away side has already clinched the series in a very convincing manner. They have looked very well-balanced and Kohli would want their form to continue.
